output.reason: New suicidal thoughts with a burden theme on a background of weeks of hopelessness, with intent, plan and means access unknown, require immediate in-person mental health crisis assessment rather than messaging.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. Thoughts that everyone would be better off without you, after weeks of feeling hopeless, need a same-hour in-person safety assessment. Call or text 988 on the way to stay connected, and ask someone you trust to stay with you. Call 911 instead if you feel you may act on these thoughts or cannot get there safely.
